memory_bridge: At one 会 meeting, a raffle ticket drops a 机会 opportunity into your hand—huì; across the table, the 会计 accountant closes the ledger on kuài. Each reading has its own station in the room.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 机会 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: Under the meeting roof, a raffle ticket drops a lucky 机会—chance—into your hand; huì falls with the ticket.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 会计 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: Across that room, the 会计 accountant totals the greetings and snaps the ledger shut; kuài falls with the cover.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 多少 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: One dusk follows another until there are too many to count; a calendar asks 多少（duō shao）, “how many?” Keep duō high and level across the accumulating evenings.
